text: Chapter 7: Upheaval in Ultimea@The Elves in Lyark
Lyark army attacked Lufenas family that is supporting\nthe partisan. Save them with the partisan!
Go to save Lepage and soldiers who have left to attack!
Wipe out the Demi Machinas surrounding Lepage and save them!
Go into the mansion with Lepage and reach where the Lyark\narmy is!
Defeat the huge and fierce Demi Machina in the hall and\nsave the people of Lufenas family confined in the room!
[[N]]Go to Lufenas Mansion: Garden from Ultimea: Outer Gate.
